title: backfill
description: One backfill run: what it listed, what it fetched, and why it stopped. Progress narration goes to stderr so this payload is the only thing on stdout.

activities.description: activities re-listed from Strava this run

pruned.description: activities deleted locally because Strava no longer lists them

streams_pending.description: activities still without streams after this run. NOT the same as work remaining — an activity Strava has no streams for stays pending forever

stopped.description: why the run ended. complete = the queue emptied; budget_reached = stopped at the self-imposed per-run read budget; rate_limited = Strava's cap, still limited after backing off

resumable.description: true when running backfill again would fetch more. Read THIS rather than streams_pending > 0
